description: $0.005 via x402: raw event logs by contract address and/or indexed topics over a block range (eth_getLogs) — the indexing primitive. Defaults to a 25-block window and narrows automatically when a node refuses on result size, and every cap or narrowing that bit is named in the response instead of silently applied. Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis.

fromBlock.description: First block of the range, decimal or 0x hex (e.g. 24000000)

toBlock.description: Last block of the range, decimal, 0x hex or latest

topic1.description: First indexed event topic (0x… 32-byte hex), optional filter

topic2.description: Second indexed event topic (0x… 32-byte hex), optional filter

topic3.description: Third indexed event topic (0x… 32-byte hex), optional filter

x_payment.description: x402 payment payload (base64) to settle this call; omit to receive the payment terms first

name: chain_event_logs
